```artifact
Feature: Doorstop Requirements Management

  Scenario: Unique and Permanent Identifiers
    Given a linkable section of text
    When I generate a unique identifier for the text
    Then the identifier is permanent and unique

  Scenario: Formatting within Linkable Text
    Given a linkable section of text with formatting
    When I view the text with formatting
    Then the text is displayed with the correct formatting

  Scenario: Storage of External Requirements Assets
    Given an external requirements asset
    When I store the asset in Doorstop
    Then the asset is stored and retrievable

  Scenario: Importing Content from Other Requirements Management Tools
    Given a requirements management tool
    When I import content from the tool into Doorstop
    Then the content is imported and viewable

  Scenario: Exporting Content to Common Text/Document Tools
    Given a document in Doorstop
    When I export the document to a common text/document tool
    Then the document is exported and viewable in the tool

  Scenario: Viewing Requirements as a Document
    Given a set of requirements in Doorstop
    When I view the requirements as a document
    Then the requirements are displayed as a document

  Scenario: Viewing Document Items Interactively
    Given a document in Doorstop
    When I view the document items interactively
    Then the document items are displayed interactively

  Scenario: Baseline Versions of Requirements
    Given a set of requirements in Doorstop
    When I baseline the requirements
    Then the requirements are baselined and viewable

  Scenario Outline: Importing and Exporting Content
    Given a requirements management tool and a common text/document tool
    When I import content from the tool into Doorstop and export it to the other tool
    Then the content is imported and exported successfully

    Examples:
      | tool | content |
      | Tool1 | Asset1  |
      | Tool2 | Asset2  |
      | Tool3 | Asset3  |

  Scenario Outline: Viewing Requirements as a Document with Formatting
    Given a set of requirements in Doorstop with formatting
    When I view the requirements as a document
    Then the requirements are displayed as a document with the correct formatting

    Examples:
      | requirement | formatting |
      | Req1        | Bold       |
      | Req2        | Italic     |
      | Req3        | Underline  |

  Scenario Outline: Viewing Document Items Interactively with Formatting
    Given a document in Doorstop with formatting
    When I view the document items interactively
    Then the document items are displayed interactively with the correct formatting

    Examples:
      | item | formatting |
      | Item1 | Bold       |
      | Item2 | Italic     |
      | Item3 | Underline  |
```
